query: Consider Ingram's Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document mention that some obligations of the Agreement may survive the termination of the Agreement?
gold: This Agreement shall remain in perpetually and upon request, Recipient will promptly return all data and materials furnished by LSUK, or provide written certification of its destruction and destroy any internal analyses and/or work papers related to these discussions.
rag_answer: No. The provided document does not expressly state that some obligations survive termination of the Agreement. It only says the Agreement “shall remain in perpetually,” but it does not include a specific survival-of-obligations clause.

judge.gold_summary: 协议永久存续；应请求，接收方须返还LSUK提供的全部数据和材料，或提供书面销毁证明并销毁相关内部分析/工作文件，体现终止后仍存续的义务。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答称文档未明确规定某些义务在协议终止后存续，仅提到协议“shall remain in perpetually”，且没有具体 survival-of-obligations clause，因此回答 No。
judge.gap: 未覆盖金标中的关键存续义务（返还材料、书面证明销毁、销毁内部分析/工作文件），并否认存在义务存续条款。
judge.reason: 系统回答虽提到“shall remain in perpetually”，但结论为 No，声称没有具体义务存续条款；这与金标证据所体现的终止后仍应履行返还/销毁义务相矛盾，因此未命中。
